editorContent.value: Drug-based modalities that travel through the bloodstream to reach cancer cells wherever they exist.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Systemic drug therapy that targets rapidly dividing cancer cells. Modern regimens are more effective and better tolerated than ever, with proactive side-effect management built into every plan.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Therapies that harness your own immune system to recognize and attack cancer cells. Checkpoint inhibitors and other agents have transformed outcomes in many cancer types.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Drugs designed to attack specific genetic mutations or proteins in cancer cells while sparing healthy tissue. Molecular profiling identifies which targets your cancer expresses.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Treatment that blocks or lowers hormones that fuel certain cancers, commonly used in breast and prostate cancer to slow or stop tumor growth.

editorContent.label: Text
editorContent.value: Image-guided technology that sees more, exposes less, and treats with millimeter accuracy.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: Precise, image-guided radiation using the TrueBeam Linear Accelerator — delivered with millimeter accuracy and gated respiration synchronization for motion-sensitive tumors.

editorContent.label: Paragraph
editorContent.value: The Omni Legend Digital PET/CT scanner delivers AI-powered, low-dose imaging with industry-leading sensitivity for precise diagnosis, staging, and treatment monitoring.
